items.title: Mozambique: Machipanda border concession tender has not been cancelled – O País
items.summary: The modernisation of the Machipanda border crossing, the largest project on the Beira Corridor, is now before the courts. The US$37 million international public tender has been suspended by a decision of the Maputo City Administrative Court, but the government insists it has not been cancelled.
